lines.text: Before you quit clipping, check which of these 4 myths you believed.
I'll bust each one, then show the setup, step by step.
Myth one: you need a big following first.
Fact: campaigns pay for the views on each clip, not followers.
A brand new page can still land a viral clip.
Myth two: clipping is easy money overnight.
Fact: the typical campaign pays about a dollar per thousand views.
So fifty thousand views earns roughly fifty bucks, not a fortune.
It adds up with volume, not with one lucky post.
Myth three: you need to be a pro editor.
Fact: the editing is quick. Finding the moment is what eats your day.
That's the part I hand to Clipzy.
Drop in a stream link, live or an old replay, and it watches the chat.
The second chat explodes, it marks the moment and clips half a minute around it.
Then it flips it vertical, facecam up top, gameplay below, captions word by word.
Keep the bangers, skip the duds, then post.
Myth four: you have to pay to get into the good campaigns.
Fact: real campaigns are free. An entry fee means a scam.
And only clip streamers or campaigns that clearly give permission.
The real recipe: a free campaign, a creator who says yes, and daily posts.
Every day you wait, someone else posts that moment first.
Comment clip, and I'll DM you how I set it up.
